outline: This course is designed to engage students in intensive study and analysis of selected issues and problems in second language acquisition. The topics covered in this course include, but are not limited to, the following: language aptitude, cross-linguistic influences, personality, motivation, leaning styles, learning strategies, language anxiety, and learners' beliefs.

3	First & second language acquisition II

9	Mid-term
10	Review of mid-term
11	Learner language
12	Foreign language aptitude
13	Motivation I
14	Motivation II
15	Affect & individual differences
16	Teaching approaches & instruction
17	Final exam
18	Review of final exam
assessment: Active class participation & activities (25%); mid-term exam (35%); final exam (40%)
